one_line_pitch_to_sam: It's a mid grey fighting game, but there's a bench that cannons you into a pool and the game roasts you in the corner when you get left hanging on a high five.

moments.why: Only remembered as 'it's a grey floor', a complaint about the look.
Sneak attack was a big number in the moment but neither brought it up.
The tower only came up as the place Robin got kicked off; the race times were used up fast.
Robin's superhero landing after being kicked off was a big shared laugh.
The 'dunked' feed line made kicking Robin back in funny; the pool itself was empty and forgotten.
The surprise launch into the pool was the best moment, though Kai also remembers the stuck-at-60 record as rigged.
Punching empty air in the first seconds felt like nothing.
Hitting the dummy felt okay but it doesn't fight back, so it didn't stick.
The guard break was clever at the time but got buried under funnier things.
Kicking Robin off the tower and into the pool is what kick is remembered for.
Block was briefly exciting for Robin but didn't change the fight and was dropped.
'You get a sword' is the whole memory.
Remembered only as 'whoever clicks first wins', the same every time.
The dummy and its challenge were just another number neither cared about.
Robin remembers being hit on the bench with no way to hit back as cheap.
Kai brags about 5-0 and Robin about 'danced on Kai', but Robin won't do more sword fights.
The parry was an accident nobody could repeat or explain.
Kai's wave missed the taunt window so nothing happened to remember.
The dance party is remembered mostly for having no music.
The unknown-emote message was just a list that led to the high five.
'Left hanging' called them out by name, and landing it on the third try felt great.
A dummy standing around made no impression.
Running for the edge and finding only grey grid is retold as a complaint.
No shop, no unlocks, 'did everything in twenty minutes' is why they stopped.
